analysis.summary: This webpage serves as the official biography page for Judge Michelle Vitt-Baker of the Eighteenth Judicial Circuit Courts in Florida. It primarily provides her contact information, location, and details about scheduling hearings within the court system. The page also contains a prominent notice about court closures due to weather and general information about employment opportunities and court operations.
key_points: Judge Michelle Vitt-Baker serves in Division 1 - Civil for Brevard County at the Titusville Courthouse.
Her Judicial Assistant is Lisa Walters, with provided phone number and email.
All court proceedings in Seminole and Brevard Counties are canceled from noon on October 8, 2024, through October 10, 2024.
The Eighteenth Judicial Circuit uses the JACs online system for attorneys to schedule hearings.
The court provides employment opportunities and is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
Business hours and contact information for Brevard and Seminole Court Administration are listed.

analysis.summary: This is a BallotReady profile page for Michelle Vitt Baker, a Brevard County Court Judge in Florida. The page provides her professional background, education, and election information, including her current term and recent candidacy.
entities: Law Offices of Michelle A Baker
Cianfrogna, Telfer, Reda, Faherty & Anderson P.A.
key_points: Michelle Vitt Baker currently holds the office of Brevard County Court Judge - Group 3 until January 5, 2027.
She was a candidate for Brevard County Court Judge - Group 3 in the 2020 Florida General Election.
Her professional experience includes serving as Judge - Division 3 since 2009, owning her own law firm from 2001-2008, and working as an associate from 1989-2000.
She holds a JD from Stetson University, a Bachelor's from University of Central Florida, and an Associate's from Brevard Community College.
